title: Product Manager lll - Never Wonder
description:
At Wyze, we make smart home technology accessible to everyone. We're known for disrupting markets with high-quality, affordable products - from cameras to lighting to sensors and more. We believe technology should simplify life, not complicate it. We’re a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team driven by curiosity and powered by data.
We are launching  Never Wonder, a strategic new product initiative to transform how people experience their homes. Never Wonder will turn raw smart-home data into personalized, AI-driven insights and recommendations — helping customers never wonder what’s happening, what to do next, or how to get more out of their homes.
What You’ll Do
Partner closely with engineering, design, and leadership to bring product strategy to life through strong execution and delivery
Take early-stage product concepts and turn them into actionable plans, requirements, milestones, and measurable outcomes
Work across AI-enabled product experiences, developing a practical understanding of how emerging AI capabilities can solve customer problems
Collaborate with design and research partners to gather user feedback, identify opportunities for improvement, and continuously iterate on product experiences
Drive day-to-day product decisions with limited oversight, identifying gaps, removing blockers, and maintaining momentum across initiatives
Translate broad business goals into concrete features, experiments, and launches that create customer and business impact
Work effectively within ambiguity, helping move ideas from approximately 60% defined to fully realized customer solutions
Coordinate with hardware, software, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of product roadmaps
Use data, customer insights, and operational metrics to evaluate product performance and inform prioritization decisions
Serve as a force multiplier for the team by increasing execution velocity and helping the organization move faster
What You’ll Bring
4+ years of product management experience delivering customer-facing products or platforms
Demonstrated ability to execute effectively in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities
Strong understanding of product development processes, including requirements gathering, prioritization, launch planning, and post-launch iteration
Ability to independently own projects and drive outcomes without requiring constant direction from leadership
Experience working collaboratively with engineering, design, research, and business stakeholders
Practical understanding of AI technologies and their application within consumer or enterprise products
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset
Excellent communication skills with the ability to align teams and drive decisions
Comfort operating in situations where strategy is partially defined and execution excellence is critical
A bias toward action and a track record of turning ideas into shipped products
Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin to communicate effectively with teams in China
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building or launching AI-powered products, features, or workflows
Experience translating strategic product direction into detailed execution plans and measurable deliverables
Familiarity with user research methodologies and data-driven product iteration
Experience working in high-growth or startup environments where ownership and adaptability are critical
Demonstrated success driving cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch
Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints while maintaining execution speed
Experience identifying opportunities to improve product quality, usability, and customer satisfaction through continuous iteration
Base Salary range of $140,000 - $190,000 DOE + bonus target up to 20% + equity
Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $140,000 – $190,000 per year.

title: Technical Project Manager - Camera Products
description:
At Wyze, we make smart home technology accessible to everyone. We're known for disrupting markets with high-quality, affordable products - from cameras to lighting to sensors and more. We believe technology should simplify life, not complicate it. We’re a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team driven by curiosity and powered by data.
The Opportunity
Wyze cameras reach millions of homes - and behind every launch is a tightly coordinated effort across teams in the U.S. and China. This role sits at the intersection of hardware and software delivery. As Technical Project Manager here at Wyze, you are tasked to be the hub of that intersection - turning product decisions and development milestones into clear plans, coordinated execution, and on-time releases. In this role, you'll own launch execution for camera hardware, help drive critical camera software initiatives, and modernize how we run projects using AI-enabled workflows. If you are fluent in hardware development lifecycles, energized by ambiguity, comfortable operating across cultures and timezones, and excited to make a distributed execution feel effortless, we'd love to talk.
What You'll Do
Drive camera product launches end-to-end
Own integrated launch plans that connect China-based development with U.S. launch readiness.
Track timelines, dependencies, risks, and decisions from concept to shelf.
Coordinate sample distribution, marketing, retail, CX, legal/finance review, and operational handoffs.
Run launch meetings that produce clear decisions and owners - not just notes.
Support camera software delivery
Partner with product, firmware, app, cloud, AI, and platform teams to move key software initiatives from planning to release.
Manage the interface between hardware stage gates and software sprint cadences - keeping software teams unblocked when hardware dependencies shift.
Support sprint planning, dependency tracking, release readiness, and beta feedback loops.
Keep ownership and timelines visible across distributed teams.
Monitor project health - milestone completion, schedule variance, blockers, issue trends - and surface what matters.
Build AI-enabled workflows that scale
Use AI tools to cut manual coordination: Meeting summaries, action tracking, risk roll-ups, beta synthesis, launch readiness updates, decision logs.
Create repeatable templates, dashboards, scorecards, and operating rhythms.
Turn scattered information across meetings, chats, and trackers into actionable intelligence.
Iterate on process based on retros and stakeholder feedback.
What You'll Bring
Hardware Experiences - Required. This means direct experience managing or coordinating consumer hardware, IoT, robotics, connected devices, or embedded systems development.
Working knowledge of hardware NPI process: You know what EVT, DVT, and PVT mean in practice, not just on paper.
Comfort being hands-on with physical devices: Running workflows on hardware, validating device behavior, understanding the difference between a firmware issue and a software issue.
3+ years in technical project management, program management, or hardware/software project management .
Proven experience working with distributed teams; experience with China-based teams strongly preferred.
Strong execution chops: project planning, dependency management, risk tracking, and driving accountability through indirect influence.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and cross-functional .issues into clear, actionable updates for product, engineering, business, and leadership audiences.
Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
Demonstrated ability to apply AI tools and automation to improve project execution, documentation quality, communication efficiency, and cross-functional coordination.
Willingness to flex working hours several days per week to overlap with China time zones.
Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken) required. Daily collaboration with teams in China is a given.
Nice to Have
Experience coordinating launches across globally distributed teams.
Background in camera technology, computer vision, or home security product categories.
What Success Looks Like
Launch plans are clear, current, and trusted by both U.S. and China teams and become more predictable and repeatable over time.
Camera software initiatives have unambiguous ownership, visibility, and cross-team coordination.
The interface between hardware stage gates and software sprints is actively managed - no one is blocked by a dependency they didn't see coming.
AI-enabled workflows measurably reduce manual follow-up and sharpen visibility into project health.
Base Salary range of $118,000 - $152,000 DOE + bonus target up to 20% + equity
Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $118,000 – $152,000 per year.
More About Us
Over the years, Wyze earned a reputation for disrupting entrenched categories and delivering products that feel almost too good to be true. That early impact brought industry recognition from Forbes, TIME, Fast Company, PCMag, and others… all signals of momentum that helped establish Wyze as a breakout brand.
Today, Wyze is focused on its next stage of company building. We’re scaling our platform, strengthening our operating rigor, and investing for long-term growth, while staying true to the belief that everyday people deserve access to great technology. This is a phase defined less by headlines and more by execution, craft, and durable impact.
Our people are central to that work. Wyze has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built in Seattle and Seattle Business Magazine, but what matters most is the environment we’re building now: one where smart, pragmatic builders take ownership, move fast, and shape what comes next.
Come Join Us!
Benefits
Wyze has a full benefits package through Premera Blue Cross. This includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life Insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, EAP, Short-term disability, Long-term disability, FSA, and Daycare FSA. Depending on the benefits package you choose, a portion of the employee and dependent premiums will be covered by Wyze.
12 Holidays - 8 set holidays and 4 Floating Holidays
24 days of PTO every year
Additional Wyze anniversary vacation days
Principal 401k Plan (no company match at this time)
Wyze is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable participation in the job application or interview process, performance of essential job functions, and access to other benefits and privileges of employment, in accordance with applicable law.
If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact recruiting@wyze.com.

title: Business Operations Manager - DTC
description:
At Wyze, we make smart home technology accessible to everyone. We're known for disrupting markets with high-quality, affordable products - from cameras to lighting to sensors and more. We believe technology should simplify life, not complicate it. We’re a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team driven by curiosity and powered by data.
The Opportunity
Wyze is hiring a Business Operations Manager to own the commercial performance of our direct-to-consumer business in North America, including wyze.com in the US and Canada. You will own pricing, promotions, assortment, and bundles across the full Wyze product portfolio. You will be accountable for revenue, promotion efficiency, and contribution profit against plan.
Your vendors are Wyze's own product lines. You will represent the DTC channel to Product, Sales, Finance, and Services. You will negotiate for the offers, launch timing, and selection that grow the channel, and work with Product to bring DTC-specific products and bundles to market.
This is a business owner role. The job requires a lot of analysis, but the goal is to make decisions and deliver results.
What You’ll Do
Own the DTC portfolio P&L levers for North America: gross revenue, net revenue, promotion spend and ROI against plan
Report against and partner with cross-functional teams on contribution profit against plan
Build the unit and revenue plan with the Head of E-commerce and own the DTC demand forecast by SKU
Set DTC prices within company pricing guidelines. Align with Sales and Finance on national promotional pricing and price matching
Own the promotion calendar: what to promote, when, at what depth, and how to measure incremental impact
Manage assortment across new launches, core products, accessories, and end-of-life SKUs. Work with Product to develop DTC-specific products
Design bundles, kits, and attach offers that grow order value and profit, including subscriptions sold on DTC
Run a weekly business review that explains what happened, why, and which actions close the gap to plan
Partner with Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Marketing, Site Development, and Customer Service to turn decisions into execution
What You’ll Bring
Bachelor’s degree in business or related field
4+ years of experience in vendor management, category management, ecommerce, retail, or related commercial role
Experience owning revenue and margin targets, with direct decisions on pricing, promotions, or assortment
Fluency in unit economics: gross and net revenue, COGS, promotion cost, and contribution profit
A track record of using data to find the highest-value lever, make a decision, and measure the result
Experience influencing cross-functional partners and senior leaders without direct authority
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills. Comfortable with SQL or BI tools
Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain tradeoffs in plain terms
Helpful, But Not Required
MBA preferred
Experience in consumer electronics, smart home, or hardware with subscription services
Amazon vendor management or DTC ecommerce experience, ideally on Shopify
Experience with demand forecasting, price elasticity, or promotion analytics
Experience building bundle, kit, or attach programs
Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $113,000 – $140,000 per year.

title: Data Scientist ll
description:
At Wyze, we make smart home technology accessible to everyone. We're known for disrupting markets with high-quality, affordable products - from cameras to lighting to sensors and more. We believe technology should simplify life, not complicate it. We’re a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team driven by curiosity and powered by data.
We're looking for a Data Scientist to help improve the quality, organization, and usability of the data that powers our AI/ML products. This isn't a reporting or dashboarding role — you'll be training, updating, and running models directly against large-scale datasets, diagnosing systemic quality issues, and building the frameworks that determine what data is fit for training. You'll work at the intersection of applied machine learning, data quality engineering, and analytical tooling.
What You'll Do
Assess and structure training data: Evaluate large-scale datasets for quality, apply structured labeling frameworks, and diagnose systemic gaps or inconsistencies that affect model performance
Train, update, and apply models against existing data: Train or fine-tune models, apply scoring/classification tools against datasets to auto-tier or flag quality at scale, and iterate on models as new data or requirements emerge
Surface insights: Explore labeling and usage patterns to find where data quality is strong or weak, and turn findings into clear, defensible recommendations
Support data pipeline integration: Partner with engineers to ensure clean, well-labeled data flows smoothly into downstream systems and model training workflows
Test and validate: Validate model outputs and quality-scoring results against ground truth before they're used downstream, and monitor for drift or regressions as data and models evolve
Contribute to tooling improvements: Provide input on internal tools used for data labeling and review, helping shape what they need to track, automate, or support
Build quality frameworks: Define metrics and benchmarks that answer “how good is our data?” and track them over time, with a direct eye toward how data quality impacts model performance
What We're Looking For
Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
1–4 years of experience in data science, machine learning, or a related quantitative field
Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals — how training data quality affects model performance, common failure modes from bad/biased data, and how to evaluate a model's output critically
Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or updating ML models — not just applying pre-built tools or doing descriptive analysis
Strong SQL and Python skills (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, or a deep learning framework such as PyTorch/TensorFlow); comfortable exploring and cleaning large, messy datasets independently
Practical experience working with AI coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as part of your daily workflow, with an agentic mindset — comfortable delegating well-scoped subtasks to AI tools/agents, verifying their output, and iterating quickly rather than hand-coding everything from scratch
Ability to translate ambiguous questions into measurable, trackable metrics
Familiarity with data labeling or annotation workflows is a plus, not required
A quality-first, curious mindset — interested in why data issues occur, not just flagging them
Exposure to computer vision or video/image datasets specifically is a plus
Success Looks Like
Measurable improvement in data quality and coverage over time
Clear, trusted quality benchmarks that inform data and modeling decisions
Strong collaboration with engineering on data pipeline health
Base Salary range of $121,000 - $150,000 DOE + bonus target up to 20% + equity
Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $121,000 – $150,000 per year.

title: Head of Supply Chain Planning
description:
At Wyze, we make smart home technology accessible to everyone. We're known for disrupting markets with high-quality, affordable products - from cameras to lighting to sensors and more. We believe technology should simplify life, not complicate it. We’re a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team driven by curiosity and powered by data.

The Opportunity
We're seeking a strategic, hands-on supply chain leader to shape how Wyze plans, operates, and scales as the business grows. Sitting at the center of market demand, inventory, supply continuity, and cross-functional execution, this role partners closely with internal stakeholders (Leadership, Sales, Finance, Product), and external international supplier partners to drive high quality decisions and inventory performance.

Why you are a perfect fit: you enjoy solving complex supply chain challenges and are looking to rethink supply chain end-to-end through automation and creativity. Wyze is a fast-changing environment, with shifting demand, product timelines, and supply constraints which all require rapid, high-quality decision-making. This role offers a chance to lead beyond reporting by building analytical algorithms, operating frameworks, improving planning quality, modernizing systems and processes, and helping accelerate AI-enabled supply chain capabilities into real day-to-day operations.

What You’ll Do
Lead and drive the S&OP process, aligning Sales, Product, and Finance while challenging assumptions, resolving conflicts, and pushing for timely, high-quality trade-off decisions
Own demand forecasting, inventory planning and decision-making, balancing demand, supply, service levels, and working capital constraints to optimize overall business performance
Drive system and process improvement across forecasting, planning and analytics workflows to improve planning efficiency, rigor, visibility, and decision-making speed
Actively manage and influence overseas suppliers to protect supply continuity, including navigating constraints, pushing back when needed, and driving mitigation plans
Lead adoption and implementation of AI-empowered applications and workflows to improve demand forecasting, inventory planning efficiency, accuracy, and team productivity
Build and drive high-performing teams: Build, lead, and motivate high-performing teams — set clear standards, recruit top talent, and create accountability structures that scale with the business.
Reimagine team design for an evolving function: Evaluate how automation and new tools change the shape of the work, and use that insight to define the team structure, roles, and skills needed to stay ahead - balancing technology and human expertise where each adds the most value.
Develop proposals and conduct presentations to leadership to facilitate critical inventory decisions

What You’ll Bring
8-10 years of direct experience in supply chain analytics, demand planning and forecasting, inventory planning, S&OP, or a closely related supply chain operation and analytical function
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect product strategy, demand generation, and supply execution across the full value chain
Track record building high-performing teams: Proven experience building, leading, and scaling high-performing teams - including hands-on recruiting/hiring and a track record of measurable team performance outcomes
Experience redesigning team structure around new technology: Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating automation/AI tools into team workflows, and restructuring roles, skills, or org design in response - not just managing a static team, but having actually changed its shape before.
Strong analytical foundation with the ability to translate data into business decisions, and the judgment to assess when data or models may be incomplete, inconsistent, or misleading
Proven ability to make high-quality decisions quickly in ambiguous, cross-functional environments with incomplete information
Experience building, maintaining, and interpreting metrics and dashboards for operational decision-making
High cross-functional skills and the ability to work effectively across Supply Chain, Product, Sales (B2B / D2C), Finance, and oversea suppliers
Strong systems thinking. You are already rethinking and rebuilding supply chain through AI/ML tools, automation, or AI-assisted workflows.
Confidence operating across U.S. and China-based stakeholders and external partners
Ability to work overlapping hours as needed to collaborate effectively with cross-geography teams and partners

Preferred experience
Experience in consumer electronics, IoT hardware, product development, e-Commerce and retail fulfillment environments
Strong SQL and Snowflake data management skills, or comparable experience with modern data warehousing and analytics tools
Experience with forecasting models, inventory optimization, and AI/ML planning approaches
Familiar with ERP, procurement, logistics, 3PL, supplier management, and fulfillment optimization tools
Mandarin language proficiency: Professional working proficiency in Mandarin, supporting direct collaboration with China-based engineering, supply chain, or manufacturing partners.

title: Social Commerce Manager - TikTok Shop
description:
At Wyze, we make smart home technology accessible to everyone. We're known for disrupting markets with high-quality, affordable products - from cameras to lighting to sensors and more. We believe technology should simplify life, not complicate it. We’re a fast-moving, customer-obsessed team driven by curiosity and powered by data.

The Opportunity
Wyze is already one of the top electronics sellers on TikTok Shop, generating millions in revenue and multiple viral products. We’re looking for a Social Commerce Manager to be the end-to-end owner Wyze's TikTok Shop and broader social commerce business. You’ll lead a strategic reset of the channel, building a sustainable operating model that’s tightly aligned with company goals and financial targets. This is a highly visible role for a builder who wants to own the P&L, shape our creator and affiliate strategy, and stand up a team and playbook in one of the fastest-growing commerce channels.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who combines strong e-commerce instincts with a scrappy, entrepreneurial mindset. You don’t need to be a content creator, but you should understand what drives conversion and how to translate social content into sales. You thrive in roles where things need to be defined and built versus someone handing you a prebuilt playbook.

What You’ll Do
Own the social commerce P&L end to end, with accountability for revenue/GMV, channel investment, contribution margin, and ROI - not just sales volume or campaign performance.
Own the end-to-end performance of Wyze’s TikTok Shop / social commerce business – strategy, roadmap, execution, and results.
Define the strategic role of TikTok Shop within Wyze’s overall channel mix and align it to company-level goals and financial targets.
Translate strategy into clear priorities, operating plans, and KPIs; decide where to invest people, budget, and partner resources.
Build and refine a stable operating model for social commerce, including processes, workflows, and vendor/partner structure.
Lead cross-functional collaboration with Product, Marketing, Creative, Logistics, Finance, BI, and Customer Support to deliver campaigns and launches.
Build and deepen partnerships with TikTok and other social commerce platforms to unlock growth programs, incentives, and new features.
Own planning and execution for key moments (e.g. Wyze Day, Black Friday/Cyber Monday, major launches) across TikTok Shop / social commerce.
Monitor business performance and creator/affiliate programs, identify risks and opportunities, and quickly adjust strategy and tactics.
Use data to inform assortment, pricing, promotional levers, and creator/influencer strategy; establish simple reporting and feedback loops.
Proactively explore and test new growth levers (creators, affiliates, live shopping formats, new markets) and scale what works.

What You Bring
5+ years of experience in e-commerce, social commerce, or marketplace roles, including at least 3 years of direct ownership of a channel or business P&L - or equivalent financial accountability
2-3 years of mentoring and leading high performance teams
Strong merchandising and commercial instincts (pricing, promotions, bundles, conversion optimization)
Analytical mindset; comfortable using data to evaluate performance and manage to financial targets (GMV, contribution margin, investment ROI, cross-channel sales impact).
Excellent collaboration and communication skills; able to lead through influence with cross-functional partners and external platforms.
Comfort building structure where it doesn’t exist yet - from team design to processes, tools, and vendor structure.
Entrepreneurial mindset - you enjoy building and improving systems in fast-moving environments
Nice-to-Haves
Experience operating or supporting TikTok Shop
Experience with creator or affiliate marketing programs
Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms
Background managing marketplace channels such as Amazon, Instagram Shop, or other social commerce platform
